findings.title: Snapshot/checkpoint parity oracle blind spot — omits journey-mutated persisted fields incl. modifiers

findings.rootCause: oracle enumerates drop surfaces, not writer surfaces
findings.repair: proposed: derive granted-list from all production writer paths and keep multiset semantics for double-registration detection

findings.title: runTribulation skips startTribulationPrepared pre-start unequip + modifier sync (equipped-through-tribulation is fixture-only state)

findings.title: drainTribulationOutcome returns true on empty director — no settle-ordering guard; settle/drain nil asymmetry
findings.discoveredBy: reviewer-a + reviewer-b + reviewer-c (triple convergent independent discovery)
findings.counterexample: call drainTribulationOutcome() before any settle/committed outcome: returns true via director.clear() on an empty director; settle throws (playerOwner guard) while drain vacuously succeeds — asymmetric nil handling
findings.expected: drain reports 'committed outcome drained' and enforces settle-before-drain ordering as production checkTribulationOutcomeAction does
findings.actual: returns true on an empty director — 'cleared-or-deferred' semantics; enables drain-before-settle order production cannot reach
findings.rootCause: seam models clear() but not the committed-outcome precondition; nil-handling asymmetric with settle
findings.repair: proposed: require committed outcome (or post-settle receipt) before clearing; align nil handling with settle

findings.title: vi.setSystemTime(Date.now()) no-op under fake timers at 3 sites

findings.title: Per-tick auto-invest during tribulation couples leg-A essence surplus to leg-D exact-tier preconditions
findings.counterexample: static+source-verified: every tribulation tick auto-invests surplus essence into body_refinement, so leg D's exact-tier assertions depend on leg-A's leftover essence minus tribulation duration — coupling via hidden per-tick side effect
findings.expected: ordered legs' exact-value preconditions are seeded directly or declared as coupling
findings.actual: leg D's precision silently relies on the leg-A surplus surviving the tribulation tick loop
findings.rootCause: production per-tick auto-invest is invisible to the leg-level assertions
findings.repair: proposed: pin essence explicitly at leg D's precondition, or assert the tick-consumption delta
